findings.text: follow-on: the gate log's `module:` header line is an annotation computed from the emitting shell's cwd rather than derived from the run itself, so it can name a tree the run never imported — the first base pass named the head worktree's imas_codex/__init__.py and both base logs had to be re-run (base-default-markers.superseded-badheader.log, base-graph-markers.superseded-badheader.log). The final headers are correct and the node discloses the supersession and its identical totals at report.md:45-49, but the header is not self-proving; the in-pytest probe base-import-provenance.log is what actually establishes the base arm measured base code.

follow-on: retry_failures opens "none" while the run's own classification record (classification.json) carries retry_counted_failures 2 for the two re-run base gate commands, so the field's text and the counted value disagree — the same record-disagrees-with-its-own-data shape s13 exists to close. No test failed in either run and the cause is stated in the same field, so nothing is hidden, but a promotion guard reading retry_counted_failures sees a number the field's own wording does not.

item_verdicts.diff: the node is a read-only test role and made no commits, so the diff of its commits against its base f0ba4fc4a is empty; its only artefacts are report.md, counts.log and seven log files under the declared reports scope, each re-read on disk.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names two gate commands at f0ba4fc4a each captured to one log whose first lines are revision and command and whose last line is an EXIT= line, the RRF arm's mean nDCG@10 from test_four_arm_table_matches_the_control_below_every_arm equal to 0.8473 to four places, the JT-60SA census 0 missing and a Cypher count of underspecified-with-role 0, and a report tabulating all of it; each is recorded and re-read on disk — head-default-markers.log (revision f0ba4fc4a, 1707 passed, EXIT=0), head-graph-markers.log:12 ("rrf": 0.8472853917655051), counts.log (missing 0, cypher 0, positive controls 225 and 14886), report.md.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to show the tests s13's nodes touched pass together at the merged head; report.md's "Gate commands and totals" table records both done-when commands green at f0ba4fc4a (default markers 1707 passed, live-graph -m graph 9 passed, each EXIT=0), and I re-read head-default-markers.log and head-graph-markers.log to confirm those totals and exit codes.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, and I re-read each cited log on disk — the four gate totals and EXIT= lines, counts.log with its positive controls, head-graph-collect.log (9/27 collected) and base-import-provenance.log all match what the manifest states.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared scope is the single directory reports/imas-codex/ssfms-cleanup-integration; every one of the ten changed_paths in the manifest lies inside it, and git status --porcelain at f0ba4fc4a in the node's worktree is empty, so no repository file was written.

justifications.durability: the node landed a report and ran no red arm, so no test fails if this verification regresses; the suites it ran are the guards of s13's code rather than a durable guard of its own deliverable, and re-running them is manual.
justifications.evidence: counts.log carries the zero beside positive controls on the same connection and facility (225 underspecified rows, 14886 role-carrying signals) so the absence is read by an instrument that can see rows, and head-graph-markers.log:12 carries the RRF figure the done-when names, printed by test_four_arm_table_matches_the_control_below_every_arm.
justifications.fit: the node added no source and its artefact names (report.md, head-default-markers.log, counts.log, head-graph-collect.log) carry no plan, version, stage or ticket label, matching the reports-scope idiom.
justifications.goal_fidelity: report.md's "Gate commands and totals" table shows both done-when commands green at f0ba4fc4a and the manifest's landing line states the same, which is exactly what the goal asks for.
justifications.reuse: the node re-ran the existing pytest suites and the production census_signal_roles rather than re-implementing a census, and added no definition that could duplicate an owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: every changed_path in the manifest is under reports/imas-codex/ssfms-cleanup-integration and git status --porcelain in the node's worktree at f0ba4fc4a is empty, so nothing outside the declared scope was written.
